trial_court: Court of MS. PRABH DEEP KAUR: DJ-05, SOUTH EAST DISTRICT, SAKET COURTS, DELHI, CS DJ NO. 6574/16
case_name: Arun Kumar Gupta vs H.T. Media Ltd Ors

parties.respondent_defendant: 1. HT Media Limited (through editor and publisher), 2. Integrix India Private Limited., 3. Mr. Atul Bansal, 4. Mrs. Vidhu Bansal, 5. Brig. (Retired) N. Kumar, 6. Mr. Pavan Duggal - Advocate Delhi High Court

facts_of_case: The plaintiff joined defendant no. 2 company as a Director on 01.09.2000 and he resigned from the said post on 05.07.2005. Thereafter, plaintiff started his own company rendering the services similar to the plaintiff company.

legal_principles.principle: A party's silence or inaction can be taken as an admission of the truth.
legal_principles.held: The plaintiff has not given any reason, much less any cogent reason, as to why he suddenly resigned from such business for no cause.

legal_principles.principle: A party's failure to provide a reason for its actions can be taken as an admission of the truth.
legal_principles.held: The plaintiff fails to give any reason, much less any cogent reason, as to why he suddenly resigned from such business for no cause.

outcome.final_order: The suit has been settled between plaintiff and defendant no. 2 to 5 vide settlement dated 25.02.2023 and between plaintiff and defendant no. 6 vide order dated 20.03.2023.

use_for_drafting: drafting a property dispute case in Delhi High Court
resolving a civil dispute through judgment
